summary: Containerized AAP 2.6 requires RHEL 9.4 or later 9.x (RHEL 10 unchanged) and supports PostgreSQL 15, 16 and 17 for external databases; with 16 or 17 you must use external backup and restore.
questions: What RHEL version does containerized AAP 2.6 need?
Which PostgreSQL versions are supported for external databases in containerized AAP?
Does AAP backup work with PostgreSQL 16?

answer_card.title: Containerized AAP 2.6 requirements
answer_card.answer_md:
- RHEL **9.4 or later** 9.x (RHEL 10 requirements unchanged)
- External DB: PostgreSQL **15, 16, 17**
- With PostgreSQL 16/17, use **external backup and restore**; built-in backup depends on PostgreSQL 15 utilities.
